assets.name: probe-runde
assets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create ONE extremely simple, intuitive flat vector-style pictogram for a breathing PRACTICE button.
Subject: a plain, recognizable pair of lungs in warm cream #e9ebe3. Add just ONE small sage #a9b99a circular repeat arrow at the lower right, outside the lungs, clearly meaning practice/rehearsal. No surrounding square, no four-part loop, no decorative rays, no extra diagrams.
Large confident solid shapes, smooth rounded geometry, minimal detail, perfectly legible at 64px. Exactly two flat opaque colors, no gradients, texture, highlights, shadows, borders, noise or outlines.
Centered balanced composition on a square canvas with 15% transparent padding. Truly transparent background, clean transparent negative space. Intended to sit on a dark #131712 button. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, branding, medical cross, or health claims.
This should feel like one simple UI symbol, not a detailed infographic. Suitable for clean SVG path tracing.

assets.name: haupt-runde
assets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create ONE extremely simple, intuitive flat vector-style UI pictogram for a RESEARCH AND DATA COLLECTION session button.
Subject: one muted sage #a9b99a clipboard with a simple warm cream #e9ebe3 clip at the top. Inside the clipboard, ONE cream data-chart trace consisting of three large round data points connected by two straight segments. The three points rise and fall slightly, like measured observations. No axes, no ticks, no text rows or checkboxes. A plain clipboard/data-recording symbol, instantly recognizable at 64px.
Very minimal smooth rounded geometry, bold clean shapes, exactly two opaque flat colors. Clipboard is an open outline with a fully transparent interior, NOT a filled rectangle. Broad outline and broad trace. No gradients, shading, shadows, noise, texture, tiny details, magnifying glasses, flasks, hearts, lungs or arrows.
Centered balanced composition on a square canvas with 15% transparent margins. Truly transparent background and clean transparent negative space. Intended to sit on a #131712 button.
No letters, numbers, words, watermark, branding, medical cross, or health claims.
One simple symbol, not a detailed infographic. Matches a companion practice pictogram made from cream lungs and a sage repeat arrow. Suitable for clean SVG path tracing.

conversion.normalization: Fit the source alpha>=180 bounds within 224x144, preserving aspect ratio, centered at (120,80). Classify opaque pixels by nearest RGB palette color before tracing; leave source PNGs intact.
